title: Glazing Job & Order Management Software | Coglass
description: Track every glazing job from first enquiry to final paid invoice in one place — statuses, notes, photos, templates and never-reused order numbers. Your whole team on the same page.
lead: From the first enquiry to the final paid invoice, every job lives in one place your whole team can see — statuses, notes, site photos and history. No more "which spreadsheet was that on?"
steps_h2: One place for the whole job lifecycle
steps_sub: Coglass moves a job through every stage — and keeps everyone looking at the same record.
inc_h2: Everything a glazing job needs, attached
inc_sub: No more juggling spreadsheets, notebooks and group chats.
steps: {{webshop::Phone, email, your website enquiry form or your webshop::Phone, email or your website enquiry form}} — the customer, site address, contacts and job description go into a new order.
Send a quote or book a survey straight from the order. Everything stays attached to the same job.
Watch the job move through new request → survey → quote → on order → glass ready → fitting → completed, with the right label for collection, delivery or glazing.
Internal notes, site photos and documents live on the order so the whole team has the full picture — office and field.
Every order gets the next number in line, and a number is never used twice — even after a job is deleted — so your records stay clean.
When the job completes, raise the invoice, take payment and push to Xero — all from the same order.
included: Full order lifecycle
Statuses from enquiry to paid, with type-aware labels for collection, delivery and glazing jobs.
Order templates
Save common jobs as templates and spin up repeat work in seconds.
Numbers never reused
Order numbers always go up and are never used twice, even after a job is deleted.
Trash and restore
Deleted orders go to the Trash first — bring one back, or remove it for good. Nothing lost by accident.
Site contacts & addresses
Multiple site and billing addresses with tap-to-call and map links.
Internal notes & photos
Thread notes and job photos against the order for the whole team.
“Needs attention”
Jobs sitting too long in one status are flagged on the Orders page and the dashboard, with a morning email to owners and admins.
Quick Go
Opens from any page: price a phone or walk-in enquiry, then send the quote or sell it there and then.
Documents
RAMS, quotes, invoices and job files all attached to the order.
Whole-team visibility
Office on the web, fitters on the app — one shared record that keeps itself in sync.
Linked extra jobs
Create a new linked job from site for the same customer, even offline.
{{portal::Customer portal::Customer quote, invoice and tracking pages}}
Each customer gets their own private link to track the job, see the quote and pay the invoice.

stories.label: Nothing forgotten
stories.h2: Jobs don’t go quiet without someone noticing
stories.sub: In a busy week the jobs that get lost aren’t the big ones — they are the phone enquiry nobody wrote down, the quote nobody chased and the order nobody placed.

items.title: Quick Go
items.problem: The phone rings while you are mid-invoice: “How much for a 600 × 400 toughened pane?” Opening a new order, finding the customer and building a quote means losing your place.
items.fix: Press Quick Go on any page. A panel opens beside what you were doing: pick the customer, or Walk-in / phone for someone new, add the glass and size, and the price shows straight away. Send the quote by text or email, save it as a draft, or sell it there and then.
see: Sealed units with the gap and spacer bar set on the line
Scaffold and access hire charged once per job
Delivery or fitting asks for the address
Cash sale for the counter: record cash, card or on account, then the receipt and the collection sign-off
Show their saving on this quote, when their price list saves them money
Message shortcuts: your own ready-made texts, set in Settings → Quick Go

items.title: Needs attention
items.problem: A quote goes out, the customer goes quiet, and three weeks later nobody has chased it. An order sits at To order because everyone thought someone else had placed it.
items.fix: Coglass watches how long each open job has sat in the same status — for example 2 days at New request, 5 days at Quote sent, 14 days at On order — and flags the ones that have gone quiet.
see: A red Needs attention tab on the Orders page and a card on the dashboard
Jobs a fitter marked for re-order at the top, with a Re-order badge
A morning email to owners and admins listing the jobs that have gone stale
Snooze 7 days when you know a job is fine

items.title: Surveys to follow up
items.problem: The surveyor has been out and the measurements are in — but the quote waits because the office didn’t know the survey was done.
items.fix: When a survey is finished the office gets a notification, and the job stays on the dashboard until it is quoted or the fitting is booked.
see: Each survey tagged Needs quote or Book fitting
Oldest first, so the longest wait is at the top
